name: Frost Blast
body:
School evocation [cold]; Level bloodrager 2, druid 2, magus 2, shaman 2, sorcerer/wizard 2, witch 2

Casting Time 1 standard action

Components V, S

Range 30 ft.

Area cone-shaped burst

Duration instantaneous

Saving Throw Fort negates; Spell Resistance yes

You release a blast of freezing air that covers the ground and creatures within the cone in a thin layer of ice. Any creature in the area takes 1d6 points of cold damage per two caster levels (maximum 10d6). Additionally, all creatures that take cold damage are fatigued for 1 minute. A successful Fortitude save halves the cold damage and negates the fatigue.
